```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

read_csv_safe <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  csv_df <- utils::read.csv(
    path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
  )
  if (nrow(csv_df) == 0) NULL else csv_df
}

tag_class <- c(
  Critical = "tag-critical", Warning = "tag-warning", OK = "tag-ok",
  Failed = "tag-critical", Passed = "tag-ok"
)

# Renders `items` (e.g. species names) as colored pill badges, echoing the
# colored lists `cli` prints to the console for the same
# critical/warning/ok-or-passed groupings, styled for HTML instead.
tag_list <- function(items, status) {
  if (length(items) == 0) {
    return('<span class="tag-empty">None</span>')
  }
  paste(
    sprintf('<span class="tag %s">%s</span>', tag_class[[status]], items),
    collapse = " "
  )
}

evaluation_status <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "evaluation_status.csv"))
species_summary <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "species_summary.csv"))
usm_summary <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "usm_summary.csv"))
```

```{=html}
<style>
.tag {
  display: inline-block; padding: 0.15em 0.7em; margin: 0.15em 0.25em 0.15em 0; # nolint: line_length_linter
  border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.9em; font-weight: 600;
}
.tag-critical { background: #fdecea; color: #c0392b; }
.tag-warning { background: #fef5e7; color: #b9770e; }
.tag-ok { background: #eafaf1; color: #1e8449; }
.tag-empty { color: #888; font-style: italic; }
.summary-block { margin: 0.5em 0 1.5em; }
.summary-block > p:first-child { margin-bottom: 0.3em; }
</style>
```

## Evaluation status

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(evaluation_status)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(evaluation_status))) {
    icon <- if (isTRUE(evaluation_status$success[i])) {
      '<span style="color:#2ecc71;">&#10004;</span>'
    } else {
      '<span style="color:#e74c3c;">&#10008;</span>'
    }
    cat(sprintf(
      "%s %s&emsp;", icon, evaluation_status$evaluation[i]
    ))
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Species evaluation

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (is.null(species_summary)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\nNo comparison done.\n:::\n\n")
} else {
  cat('<div class="summary-block">\n')
  cat("<p>The following species show at least one variable with:</p>\n")
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>Major degradation</strong><br>\n%s</p>\n",
    tag_list(
      species_summary$species[species_summary$status == "Critical"],
      "Critical"
    )
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>Minor degradation</strong><br>\n%s</p>\n",
    tag_list(
      species_summary$species[species_summary$status == "Warning"],
      "Warning"
    )
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>No degradation</strong><br>\n%s</p>\n",
    tag_list(species_summary$species[species_summary$status == "OK"], "OK")
  ))
  cat("</div>\n\n")
}
```

## USM evaluation

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (is.null(usm_summary)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\nNo USM evaluation data.\n:::\n\n")
} else {
  cat('<div class="summary-block">\n')
  cat("<p>The following species have at least one failed USM:</p>\n")
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>Failed</strong><br>\n%s</p>\n",
    tag_list(
      usm_summary$species[usm_summary$failed_usms > 0], "Failed"
    )
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>Passed</strong> (all USMs ok)<br>\n%s</p>\n",
    tag_list(
      usm_summary$species[usm_summary$failed_usms == 0], "Passed"
    )
  ))
  cat("</div>\n\n")
}
```
